mapper.insert: INSERT INTO idempotency_records ( id, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_status, response_body, created_at, expires_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{operation}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, NULL, NULL, #{createdAt}, #{expiresAt} ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, operation, idempotency_key) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, operation, idempotency_key, request_hash, response_status, response_body::text AS response_body, created_at, expires_at FROM idempotency_records WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND operation = #{operation} AND idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey}
mapper.update: UPDATE idempotency_records SET response_status = #{responseStatus}, response_body = CAST(#{responseBody} AS jsonb) WHERE id = #{id} AND response_status IS NULL AND response_body IS NULL
